result.reason: The frequency, notice, business-hours, independent-auditor, confidentiality, and no-systems-access requirements reach the preferred position. However, the cost-shifting trigger remains any discrepancy above 5%, rather than an underpayment above 5%; this could shift costs for an overpayment or other discrepancy and therefore does not satisfy either playbook position. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated intent, though placing the cost paragraph before the audit right creates an avoidable antecedent and organizational issue.
